newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines' Ramos checks out of hospital.
newsitem.headline: Philippines' Ramos checks out of hospital.

text.p: Philippine President Fidel Ramos checked himself out of hospital on Friday a day after being admitted complaining of joint pains, doctors and officials said.
Ramos, 68, was admitted to the Makati Medical Centre on Thursday night and was advised to remain until Sunday, physician Raul Fores said.
"All tests performed on him indicate a protracted systemic viral infection," Fores said.
But doctors said Ramos checked himself out, cancelling all but two of his scheduled official engagements.

Fores said Ramos had promised to return to hospital after a state reception on Friday night and would stay overnight for He added however initial tests showed the president was "suffering from nothing more serious than a flu".
"We've been trying to tell him to slow down...but he's the president... How can we tell a president to stay?" Fores said.
Officials in the presidential palace said Ramos attended a ceremony to present awards to overseas Filipinos and was expected to host Luxembourg's Prince Henri at a state reception on Friday night.
Officials said Ramos had cancelled a trip to the southern Philippines scheduled for Sunday.
